newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Autoindustries shares list at 8.0 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Autoindustries shares list at 8.0 rgt.

text.p: Shares of Malaysian automotive-parts maker Autoindustries Ventures Bhd made their debut at 8.0 ringgit against a 2.90 ringgit offer price.
The company offered 3.95 million new and vendor shares for listing on the Second Board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
Around three minutes into the opening, the stock was at 8.10 ringgit, having traded between 8.0 and 8.40 ringgit, on volume of 417,000 shares traded.
Autoindustries forecast net earnings of 7.16 million ringgit or earnings per share (EPS) of 28.6 cents for the year ended December 31, 1997.
For 1996, the company posted net profit of 6.1 million ringgit and EPS of 1.21 ringgit on a smaller share capital base.
